email_body:
Dear Loop Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Community & Social Media Associate role. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content, SEO, and social media integration, I'm excited about the opportunity to bring my skills to Loop and help build genuine connections with your community.

In my current role at Episto, I manage content and websites, but I've also developed a strong instinct for what makes people engage online. On my own project, mirook.com, I've not only built the site but also integrated social media and created content that resonates with the audience. I'm comfortable with the day-to-day of social media, from scheduling to replying, and I'm eager to learn more about community management and organic social.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I'm available to work in the office. I'm proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely excited about talking to people online. I'd love to bring my point of view and creativity to Loop.

I've attached my CV and would be thrilled to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Loop Team,

When I read that you're looking for someone who catches the conversation, replies like a person, and turns online chatter into action, I felt that described exactly what I love doing. As a junior digital marketer with a technical edge, I've spent the last year building and optimizing mirook.com, a WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. There, I didn't just focus on SEO—I also integrated social media, wrote content, and engaged with the audience. I learned that community isn't a calendar; it's a living, breathing thing that needs attention and authenticity.

At Episto, I've honed my ability to write content that people actually want to read, and I've become comfortable with the tools that measure whether it's working. But what truly excites me is the human side: replying to comments, spotting a trend that fits, and knowing when to jump in or step back. I have a genuine instinct for internet culture—I'm the person who notices how humor shifts across Instagram and TikTok, and I'm not afraid to bring my own voice to the table.

I'm proactive by nature. When I see an opportunity, I go for it. I'm also hungry for feedback because I know that's how I'll grow. I'm curious about using AI to make social listening smarter, and I'm not afraid of the small stuff—captions, tags, timing—because I know they matter.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just outside Antwerp, and I'm ready to be in the office, to be part of the team, and to help Loop be part of the conversation. I'd love to talk about how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
